review_texts.text: Mittagszeit im Gasthaus zum Schwanen mitten in der malerischen Altstadt von Füssen. Innerhalb von wenigen Minuten haben sich fast alle Plätze auf der Terrasse und in der Gaststube gefüllt. ... Jedes Gericht wird mit viel Liebe zum Detail angerichtet, bevor es serviert wird. „Ich versuche die Produkte bestmöglich auf den Teller zu bringen. Das Auge isst ja mit.“ Keine Massenware, keine Fertiggerichte – der Koch hat nur mit hochwertigen, frischen und möglichst vielen Zutaten aus der Region Freude am Kochen.

„Wir machen fast alles selbst“, erzählt Maria Pickl, die das Gasthaus ihrer Familie seit 2021 zusammen mit ihrem Mann Florian führt. „Selbst jede Portion Spätzle hobeln wir frisch. Die Eier kommen aus Seeg, Wild beziehen wir von einem befreundeten Jäger aus Hohenschwangau, die veganen Spinatknödel lassen wir von einer Manufaktur aus Berwang liefern.“

Schwanen on Brotmarkt Street combines centuries-old tavern tradition with modern culinary art. The menu ranges from Allgäu Kässpatzen to roast beef with onions to regional game dishes. The historic ambiance with wood paneling and tiled stove makes the evening perfect. Reserve well in advance on weekends. Try the Allgäu Kässpatzen.

review_texts.text: Hinten in der Küche bereitet Küchenchef Armin Goetz gerade das wahrscheinlich beliebteste Gericht im Hechten zu: Allgäuer Kässpatzen – oder Kässpätzle, wie sie auf der Speisekarte stehen. Auch Einheimische sagen, dass es hier die besten Kässpatzen in der Stadt gebe. ... „Wichtig ist eine selbst gemachte Fleisch- oder für Vegetarier eine Gemüsebrühe sowie die richtige Käsemischung – optimalerweise aus jüngerem und gereifterem Bergkäse, Allgäuer Emmentaler, Weißlacker oder Romadur, der ist ein bisschen gefälliger.“ ... „Wir schwenken sie noch kurz in der Pfanne und geben Röstzwiebel drüber.

Heute kommen neben Gästen aus aller Welt weiterhin viele Einheimische gerne in das Lokal, um die „schwäbisch-bayerische Schmankerlküche“ mit Flädlesuppe, Maultaschen, gebratenen Serviettenknödelscheiben, Schweinshaxe und Rindsroulade zu genießen. ... „Bei uns können die Leute ohne große Schnörkel zu einem vernünftigen Preis gut essen“, meint Florian Pfeiffer.

Located directly at the town hall, Hechten is one of the oldest inns in Füssen. The down-to-earth Bavarian-Swabian cuisine with homemade Maultaschen and roast pork has delighted generations. In summer: use the courtyard.

stores.short: 栗の木陰のビアガーデンと猟獣料理
stores.desc: 旧市街入口のカイザー・マクシミリアン広場に面した老舗ホテルの食堂。赤と白の間、歴史ある大広間、昔ながらのビアシュトゥーベに加え、市内中心で最後となった栗の木のビアガーデンがある。昔から鹿など猟獣料理で知られ、平日昼は日替わりも。

review_texts.text: Innen vereint das Restaurant gleich mehrere Bereiche: das Rote und Weiße Zimmer, den historischen Saal und eine original bayerische Bierstube. ... Bekannt ist der Hirsch seit langem für seine Wildgerichte. Die bereitet der Koch besonders gerne zu und schöpft bei der Zubereitung aus seinen Erfahrungen aus dem Schwarzwald. ... Die klassisch geprägte bayerische Karte des Hirschen mit Schweinefilet, Bachforelle und Kaspressknödel, spickt er darüber hinaus mit mediterranen Gerichten wie einem Vitello tonnato oder auch asiatisch mit einem Roten Thai Curry.

Hochsommer, 29 Grad, die Mittagssonne brennt wie durch ein Vergrößerungsglas auf die Dächer der Stadt. Doch im Hirschgarten schirmen die stattlichen Kastanienbäume die Strahlen mit ihren Blätterkronen ab und fächeln den Gästen Luft zu. „Hier ist es immer zwei bis drei Grad kühler.“

stores.yomi: フリューリングスガルテン
stores.short: 兄弟シェフの地産地消ガストホーフ
stores.desc: 旧市街から徒歩数分の保養地区バート・ファウレンバッハにある家族経営ホテルの食堂。星付き店で修業した兄弟が厨房に立ち、ゼーク産の子牛・雄牛、フォルッゲン湖のレンケ（白身魚）など地元食材で郷土料理と創作皿を作る。地元客も多い。
stores.sig: Spinatknödel mit Bergkäse（ほうれん草の団子に地元の山のチーズとカレー風味マンゴーチャツネ。店の定番）

taste.quote: Besonders beliebt bei den Gästen sind auch die Spinatknödel mit heimischem Bergkäse und Curry-Mango-Chutney – mittlerweile ein Klassiker im Frühlingsgarten.

review_texts.text: Aus den regionalen Grundprodukten zaubern sie dann ein geschäumtes Süßkartoffel-Chilisüppchen, ein „Local STEAK“ mit Schwarzbrot, Bergkäse, Radi und mariniertem Spinat oder ein gebratenes Renkenfilet vom Forggensee auf Kartoffel-Fenchelragout mit Pfifferlingen. Besonders beliebt bei den Gästen sind auch die Spinatknödel mit heimischem Bergkäse und Curry-Mango-Chutney – mittlerweile ein Klassiker im Frühlingsgarten.
Dieses familiäre Hotelrestaurant serviert frische Produkte und internationale Küche bei gutem Preis-Leistungs-Verhältnis.

A surprising combination: at Frühlingsgarten, Asian flavors meet Allgäu ingredients. Particularly recommended are the handmade dim sum and Thai curries with regional vegetables. The modern, bright decor creates a relaxed atmosphere.

review_texts.text: Hubert Maucher kocht seitdem im Maucher's, worauf er Lust hat. Deshalb ist die Tageskarte auch größer als die Standardkarte mit Klassikern wie Rostbraten, Schnitzel und Kässpätzle. ... So kauft er möglichst viele seiner Zutaten regional ein und zaubert daraus zum Beispiel sein Allgäuer Trio aus Maultasche, Kaspressknödel und Krautkrapfen. Auch sein fluffiger, karamellisierter Kaiserschmarrn ist bei den Gästen beliebt. Hubert Maucher kocht auch gerne Schmorgerichte wie Rinderschmorbraten mit Blaukraut, weil diese in der Gastronomie heute seltener als früher angeboten werden.

I have the potato soup and the smoked trout salad. And as a fisherman and someone who eats fish a lot, that was the best smoked trout I have ever had. And the sunset across the lake should allow me to put seven stars instead of just five.

We did not book and when we attended early in the night to make a booking for a little later we were told they only had a time at 8pm. That was fine. And well worth coming back for. The waitress was very friendly and patient as we cannot speak German. The food was amazing and the beer was the most delicious. I only wish I had room for dessert.

Do you want to taste the best Zwiebelrostbraten  you've ever had?  Then here is the place. I was just delighted with the experience, soft steak, crispy onions and a mouth watering sauce. The Staff/owners are this sweet couple, very attentive and friendly. Definitely coming back on our next visit to the south. Kaiserschmarrn is also a must if you feel like dessert.
We wanted some quintessential German cuisine and this didn't disappoint. Was the best beef I've ever had after an amazing day. 100% recommend as a non German speaking tourist x

The service is professional, fun and very kind.
The food is outstanding! We had the cheese soup which gets 5 stars, Feldsalat that gets 4 stars, Kraut wickel 5 stars - just like grandma did them, Schweinefilet with Sherry sauce and mushrooms and spinach dumpling get also 5 stars this was sooo good.
Beers are also very good, the local breweries around are top!
Location is close to the lake, but no view. Anyway focus in the meal.
They have changing meals additionally to their Main menu.
We come back next time when we are around
Thank you

review_texts.text: Stumbled in here by chance and ended up coming back two days later. White sausage and pretzel were solid, exactly what I needed after walking around all morning. Staff actually took time to chat, not just the usual quick service. Place is small but that's part of the charm.
The schnitzel was perfectly crispy, and that goulash soup warmed me right up. Cozy little place, prices felt fair for what you get.

The apple strudel here was honestly the best I’ve had in a long time. The staff even took a minute to show us how to eat the white sausages properly, which was super helpful. We came with a few friends and it turned into such a cozy little afternoon. Just wish the table wasn’t so close to the door, got a bit chilly.

stores.name: Restaurant Ludwigs（Hotel Ludwigs）
stores.yomi: ルートヴィヒス
stores.short: 目抜き通りで毎日通し営業の郷土料理

review_texts.text: The Maultaschen here are solid. I've had them at a few places around Stuttgart and these rank up there. The Ludwigs Spritz was a nice touch too. Service stood out though. I left a hair tie behind and the server actually remembered me the next evening and handed it back. Small thing, but you don't see that often.

The schnitzel was properly crispy, seasoning on point. Apple strudel with vanilla sauce stole the show though—that sauce alone is worth the visit. Server was friendly, quick with a joke. Solid lunch stop if you're in the area.

The sausage platter and cheese Spätzle were solid. Portions felt fair for what you pay, which I always appreciate. Service was quick too, so we weren't stuck waiting around. Nothing fancy, but for a casual dinner it did the job. Wouldn't mind coming back if I'm in the area again.

stores.desc: ホーエンシュヴァンガウのチケットセンター隣、黄色い老舗ホテルの食堂。バロックの間、ホーエンシュヴァンガウ城を望むテラスと暖炉の間、木張りの八角形の間があり、軽食向きのビストロも併設。ケーゼシュペッツレ、グラーシュなど郷土料理が中心。
stores.sig: Rindergulasch mit Semmelknödel（牛肉のパプリカ煮込みにパン団子を添えた南ドイツの定番）

taste.quote: グラーシュのスープ（ソース的スープ）のなんとも言えない味わいに酔いしれちゃうので。…いつまでも食べていたいグラーシュ＆クヌーデルでした

review_texts.text: こちらが、Hotel Müller内にあるRestaurant Müllerで頂ける、 Rindergulasch Semmelknödel です！！ … 牛肉たっぷりのグラーシュに、巨大なクヌーデルが二つ入っています。 … グラーシュは超濃厚で、重たいスープですが、そんなに味は濃くないんです。 … グラーシュのスープ（ソース的スープ）のなんとも言えない味わいに酔いしれちゃうので。 クヌーデルもしっかりとしたクヌーデルで、「主食的」な役割を果たしていました。 いつまでも食べていたいグラーシュ＆クヌーデルでした＼(^o^)／ 牛肉も大きくて、むっちりしていて、赤身多めで、食べ応えのあるお肉でした。

Very nice restaurant with local specialities and generous serving.
You would prefer the indoor option in the evening for a sharper service and a great view of the castle.
Service is professional and friendly.

THE BEST IN THE AREA!,  we visited the castle in winter and just wanted to have some coffee and keep warm but we were surprised! Food is delicious, prices are good but the best is the very friendly service.  MARTHA  was amazingly friendly and we felt like home. 100% recommended.

This restaurant is right below the Hohenschwangau Castle, very convenient for food and beverage. We had a king prawns pasta and a beef salad. Food was really taste and atmosphere was really good. Service can be improved as we can't find our server after we ordered our food lol.

Food is pretty decent. View is unbeatable. We got sat at the corner dining area with a full view of the Neuschwanstein. Can't complain on that.

Food is really quite good for a touristy place.

I was there along with my partner and we enjoyed the main dish and especially the apple strudel.
The service was friendly and fast.
Maybe was a kind of expensive.

Solid Wiener Schnitzel, crispy and not dry. Fried potatoes were good too. Vaulted ceiling gives it a nice vibe. Service was friendly.

Solid choice if you want traditional German food without the tourist-trap pricing. I had the perch — decent portion, cooked properly, and the bill felt fair for what came to the table. Place looks nice inside too. Service was friendly enough, nothing to complain about.

-it felt a bit like this place is the touristic place everyone goes to.

There are three big rooms and plenty of tables so when you are lucky, you can have a choice of where to sit, depending on occasion. The atmosphere is homely and friendly. Waitresses are dressed in traditional outfits. The food is reasonably priced and portions are big. As you can expect the menu is full of traditional dishes so unfortunately for vegans there is only a few options available, from separate asparagus menu or you can choose side salads. Do make sure you tell them you are a vegan or vege

review_texts.text: Lohnenswert ist hier eine Einkehr im Berggasthaus Bleckenau, dem ehemaligen königlichen Jagdhaus von Ludwig II. Heute ist die urige Hütte ein beliebtes Ausflugsziel, um in einer gemütlichen Atmosphäre mitten in der Bergwelt allerlei kulinarische Leckereien zu genießen. Bekannt ist das Berggasthaus Bleckenau unter anderem für die köstlichen Wildspezialitäten, die es hier gibt.

Diese bewirtschaftete Berghütte auf 1167 m diente dem König einst als Jagdschloss. Urig ist es im Inneren der Hütte, gemütlich draußen auf der Terrasse. Mountainbiker brauchen eine gute Kondition für die Auffahrt. Im Winter ist die Hütte Ausgangspunkt für rasante Rodelpartien.

review_texts.text: Hier müssen Naschkatzen definitiv stark sein, sonst schleichen sich neben das Stück Sachertorte noch eine Käse-Sahne oder eine Rhabarber-Rumtorte auf den Teller. Sahne, Cremes und Bisquitböden sind hier wie Himmelsleitern geschichtet und Häppchen für Häppchen klettern Tortenliebhaber damit schnurstracks ins Paradies. Auch Kuchen-, Pralinen- und Eisfans werden im Kurcafé glücklich, ebenso Veganer, für die es eine spezielle Auswahl gibt. Alles ist handgemacht - mit Liebe, ganz viel Erfahrung und ohne künstliche Zusatzstoffe.

25 verschiedene Pralinensorten gibt es zur Auswahl - je nach Jahreszeit eher fruchtig-frisch wie die Limetten- oder Orangentrüffel oder mit Bratapfel und Glühwein zur Winterszeit. Auch "Trendgebäck" wie die Macarons oder die berühmt gewordene Orientschokolade mit Pistaziencreme werden hier hergestellt.

Ein zentrales Element des Gesamtkonzepts bleibt auch die Konditorei des Kurcafé Füssen. Im neuen Verkaufsbereich dürfen sich die Besucher auf Torten, Schokoladen, Pralinen und Manufaktur-Eis freuen – übrigens alles aus eigener Herstellung, betont die Konditorei.

review_texts.text: Vieles davon stellt sie selbst her wie Sirupe, Marmeladen, Aufstriche und Kuchen. Zum Frühstück gibt es außerdem Milch, Käse und Joghurt aus dem Allgäu oder ein Buchweizen-Crunchymüsli mit wenig Zucker, das sie ebenfalls selbst macht. „Das ist doch zehnmal besser als gekauft und so weiß ich, was drin ist. Mein Maßstab: Alles, was ich hier anbiete, dürften meine Kinder auch essen und da bin ich schon streng", erzählt die Cafébesitzerin.

Mittags bietet sie immer ein leichtes Gericht an, zum Beispiel eine geeiste Gazpacho im Sommer oder einen Eintopf im Winter. review_texts.text: Den Kaffee bezieht Rainer Herb von einer Rösterei in Waltenhofen, im kleinen Shop gibt es welchen vom Gardasee und andere italienische Spezialitäten zu kaufen. Guter Kaffee ist für ihn reine Geschmackssache. „Für mich braucht er eine gute Stärke und er darf nicht bitter sein. Wenn man ihn trinkt, muss man einen Wow-Effekt auf der Zunge haben." Dazu können die Gäste ganz stilecht zwischen einer Torta della Nonna, einem Tiramisu, einem Zitronenkuchen oder anderen feinen Kuchen wählen, die alle im Allgäu gebacken werden.

Das Caffè Lucca ist eines der beliebtesten Cafés in Füssen. Vielleicht kennst du ja das Caffè Torino in Marktoberdorf oder das Caffè Roma in Kempten – alle drei gehören zum gleichen Familienbetrieb der Basoni-Familie. Hier gibt es alles: von Frühstück über Kuchen, verschiedene Kaffeesorten zum Kaufen bis hin zu Schulungen, in denen dir alles rund um das Thema Kaffee genau erklärt wird. Wenn du in Füssen einen entspannten Ort mit Blick auf die Fußgängerzone suchst, bist du im Caffè Lucca genau richtig.

review_texts.text: Bei einer Ausfahrt warten in den umliegenden Restaurants in Füssener Teilorten ähnliche kulinarische Überraschungen. Eine Radtour führte uns an den Hopfensee, wo wir im Seaside zu Mittag essen konnten. Wie wir später feststellten, eilte dem Bistro der gute Ruf für sein Eis und seine Kuchen zurecht voraus. Im Anklang an die Bezeichnung des Hopfensees als Riviera des Allgäus bietet die Küche internationales Flair zwischen Snack und edlem Tellergericht. So gibt es einerseits Flammkuchen, Burger oder Bruschetta oder Süßkartoffel-Fries, aber auch exquisite Speisen, die häufig auf der Tageskarte zu finden sind.

„Es gibt so ein paar Klassiker, die werden immer bei uns nachgefragt wie die Himbeerbaisertorte, der Zwetschgenstreusel und die Apfel-Zimtsahne. Gerne probieren wir auch mal etwas Neues aus." ... doch das Seaside ist seit jeher bekannt für seine großen und leckeren Kuchenstücke.

taste.quote: The roasted duck is outstanding, perfectly crispy skin, tender meat, and rich, comforting flavors. Their home-brewed beer is excellent, fresh, and well balanced, pairing beautifully with the food.

review_texts.text: Im Schlossbrauhaus können sich die Gäste auf einer Schlemmerreise mit frisch zubereiteten Gerichten durch die regionale und bayerische Küche verwöhnen lassen. Neben den täglichen Schmankerln wie Ofenfrischer Leberkäs oder Geschmorte Kalbsbäckchen findet man auf der Speisekarte Spezialitäten wie Allgäuer Bergkäs Rahmsuppe, Allgäuer Krautkrapfen und den beliebten, täglich frischen Brauhausbraten vom Schweinehals (nur solange der Vorrat reicht). Dazu mundet ein braufrisches Bier aus der eigenen Brauerei mit dem unverwechselbaren Geschmack.

Amazing food. I had meatloaf with some amazing mushroom sauce. Beer was great and the Helles had a slightly fruity, almost Kolsch like flavor that helped it stand apart from the Helles in Munish. Waiter was friendly and more than willing to speak to us in English. Finally the Haussschnaps was amazing. Had to get a bottle to bring home.

Had lunch here after visiting Hohenschwangau which was nearby. It was one of the only well rated restaurants so I decided to give it a try. It was a bit hard understanding how to get a table because there was no one to welcome you. We managed to find someone at the bar and they found a waiter who took care of us.

Service was rather quite and the staff was nice too. The main room of the restaurant is very spacious and busy. There was a lot of noise but we were sat in a cosy area near the stage which was great.

The food was generous and good. I had the beer battered fish with a potato salad. M

We came here after building up an appetite after the castle tour. There was no apparent host stand so we walked up to the barkeep for seating direction and once seated had a server take our order. The food was really good and wait time was minimal, would definitely eat here again!

Service is friendly and attentive without being intrusive. Staff are knowledgeable about the different brews and happy to offer recommendations based on your preferences.

Overall, this Brewery delivers great beer, beautiful surroundings, and a memorable experience. It is definitely worth a visit.

Stopped for lunch before we went to the castle and it couldn't have been better. Great beer garden with castle view. The food and beer were fantastic. We had the pretzel with lard (so good), the Shepard's Schnitzel, and the goulash. Definitely stop by when going to the castle.

On the way to Neuchwanstein castle, we visited here for lunch. I noticed most of the reviews mentioning about service and lack of hosts for seating. For us, booking was done by our tour guide and didn't face any difficulty getting seats. So, always call them and reserve. This helps.
We got a limited menu from tour guide and I went for this trilogy dumpling (veg). It was surprisingly tasty! Wife had beer batterd fish fillet and she told that was also good. Kid went for currywurst and that also was yummy. They have nice dunkel beer also there. Very light and refreshing. They have an extensive me
The view of the castle from outside is the whole reason to come. Inside is meh, service was hit or miss.

stores.name: Markthalle Füssen
stores.yomi: マルクトハレ
stores.short: 15世紀の市場館で魚スープとワイン
stores.desc: 15世紀の旧穀物倉を使った旧市街の屋内市場。チーズ・パン・青果の店に混じってワインとビールのカウンターと魚屋の食堂があり、魚のスープや燻製ウナギのサンド、ケーキを立ち寄りで味わえる。天井の高い館内は落ち着いていて、昼の軽食や一杯に向く。
stores.sig: Fischsuppe（魚屋カウンターの魚のスープ）
stores.reason: 2023〜25年の Google クチコミ（Wanderlog 掲載）で「今まで食べた中で最高の魚スープ」「燻製ウナギが絶品」と味の言及が複数。歴史的建築の中で軽く飲み食いでき、日曜休みに注意。

taste.quote: The fish soup is prolly the best one I've ever eaten. The smoked eel is sooo good also, sandwiches there are solid as well!

review_texts.text: Amazing spot. The fish soup is prolly the best one I've ever eaten. The smoked eel is sooo good also, sandwiches there are solid as well!

Located in a very busy marketplace, and we found it randomly after giving up on phone GPS unable to work the narrow windy lanes. We were underwhelmed. There are a handful food choices (and not a wide selection as some guidebooks might suggest). Seems wurst-free! The tall building is from 15th century but we could not find a way to admire its ceiling.

Best fish soup I've ever had. The dessert was very nice, delicious and it was not too sweet. The pretzel was pretty fluffy. (It was the best pretzel I've ever had). Lastly the lady that served us was extremely nice and warm.

Markthalle Füssen is a great place to visit for anyone who loves fresh produce and local goods. The market hall is a large, bustling space with a wide variety of products and vendors, making it a great spot to explore. The stalls offer a variety of fresh fruits and vegetables, meats, cheeses, and more, all of which are sourced locally and of the highest quality. The staff at the market are friendly and helpful, making it a pleasant experience for all. The prices are reasonable and it's a great way to support local farmers and businesses. All in all, Markthalle Füssen is a wonderful place to vi
Great mix of food and drinks counters in an airy pleasant atmosphere.  The coffee and cake were excellent after a cycle round the lake.  Fabulous
Interesting! Stopped for a drink and it's an actual market with deli and fish counter. A bit of a culture  shock. Great atmosphere and good value on drinks
Perfect for a quick beer or a glass of wine and a snack, while visiting Fussen I suggest  you to try the fish !
A beautiful old City. So many stores and little shops. A little bit of everything for everyone.

stores.name: La Perla Ristorante Pizzeria
stores.yomi: ラ・ペルラ
stores.short: 旧市街の家族経営の窯焼きピッツァ
stores.desc: 旧市街ドレーアー小路にある長年続く家族経営のリストランテ。薄くカリッとした生地のピッツァ、シーフードリゾット、アスパラガス添えサーモンなど季節の皿を、テラス席でも味わえる。店主自らおすすめを熱心に説明してくれる温かな接客で知られる。
stores.sig: Pizza（カリッと焼いた生地に具をたっぷり載せた窯焼きピッツァ）

taste.quote: Both pizzas were excellent. The dough was crunchy and they were generous with the toppings. We also had tomato soup which was really savoury.

review_texts.text: We went for lunch and ordered soup and a pizza to share as starters, followed by pasta for our main course. The service was quick and efficient. Everything was delicious and so tasty! It was like falling into an Italian dream. Amazing—definitely a great Italian restaurant that shouldn’t be missed.

We ordered some pizza and Carbonara. Both pizzas were excellent. The dough was crunchy and they were generous with the toppings. We also had tomato soup which was really savoury. The carbonara, on the other hand, was dry. The eggs were cooked and it lacked flavour.  Nevertheless, we enjoyed our stay here because of the impeccable service. All the staff were very friendly and accommodating.
One of our best experience in Germany! Staff look happy working there and were very friendly. Seafood Risotto was superb. We love Martin and friend!
The food here is so good! Great staff and atmosphere! Highly recommend!

Pizzas were super good and delicious! The crust was very good as well. I can also recommend Bruschetta, Lambrusco and Ginger-Ale here.  Service was very good and the waiter was very friendly and kind.
It was really welcomed atmosphere, what is really rare in Germany. The taste and structure of risotto wasn't the best, but drink and the waiter was absolutely focused on us.

We had an absolutely wonderful family dinner here! The pizzas were delicious, but what truly blew us away was the incredible hospitality. They took such genuine, sweet care of our daughter, making her feel so incredibly special.

The food was amazing and the owner of the restaurant was very kind 👍 I asked for the recommendation and the owner of the restaurant explained everything passionately with kindness. We got the 200 and the salmon dish with asparagus which the chef recommended us.

review_texts.text: Very belated review of this wonderful spot!! Great food, wonderful service. So enjoyed our evening!! Hope to visit again.

We had a very tasty dinner here. The food was amazing. We tried zucchini from the starters and then a shared plate with sardelen, octopus and calamari, all were so crispy and juicy. Location is central but on a calmer street so it’s perfect for a conversation as well. For all we ate and drink price was also very good.
Nice atmosphere, competent and friendly staff, and outstanding Greek food! I can highly recommend the fish dishes. The portions are generous, and quality is good for the price point.
The ingredients of the dishes are so fresh. Staff are friendly. They gave us the ouzo for free :) highly recommended!

We had a wonderful experience here, and my only regret is that I did not get the owner/server's name!  I saw it on our walk through Fussen on Monday, and we decided to come back for dinner - a change from Bavarian cuisine.  Our starters were delicious. Lovely garlicky eggplant dip with pita; the best dolmadakia I've ever tasted.  It was tender, unlike most others which are dry!  Our mains were a Feta Saganaki salad, grilled calamari and again, an eggplant Auflauf.  We shared a dessert we hadn't heard of or tried before - Portokalopita - it was to die for.  We had to have some ouzo for digestio
Bitte Parakalo! Super good service and excellent food, just like if you are in a Aegean Island! Vladimir attended us in a great way and the lunch was amazing, for sure we’ll repeat!
Everything was very tasty and everyone was very polite. Food is awesome

stores.yomi: アンナプルナ
stores.short: 駅近の本格インド・ネパール料理
stores.desc: フュッセン駅から徒歩圏、ケンプテン通りのインド料理店。タンドリーチキン、カラヒ・チキン、ラム料理、ガーリックナンなどを、辛さの希望に応じて作ってくれる。観光の中心から少し外れ地元客が多い。テラス席あり、向かいに有料駐車場。
stores.sig: Karahi Chicken（鉄鍋カラヒで煮込むトマトと香辛料の鶏カレー）

taste.quote: We asked for spicy and they cooked as requested. The nan is one of the nicest we have had, so is the chicken tikka.

review_texts.text: Randomly decided on this restaurant and it turned out to be a gem. Definitely recommend if you are in the surroundings. Very tasty, and friendly staff. The service is quick too!
Amazing food. The hotel owner Dev was a very friendly guy. Really nice location and easy parking plus with great views. Happy to come back again!
A hidden gem with absolutely delicious freshly made food! Some of the best Indian cuisine we've ever had, highly recommend!

Fantastic food, large portions. We recommend the lamb dishes #66 and #70 and the garlic naan, those were great! The owners are kind and we were glad we stumbled across this restaurant. It is the perfect break from the touristic center of Füssen and you see more locals here. The only side effect from that is that the atmosphere was different. At the time we were the only guests indoor (outdoor is next to a busy street), so it was a little quiet and not much going on. However don't let it keep you from dining here because it did not influence our experience in any way.

Excellent halal food in Fussen - generous portion and extremely tasty. We asked for spicy and they cooked as requested. The nan is one of the nicest we have had, so is the chicken tikka. Highly recommended. Will come again if we are in the area again.

I wish we had Indian food this delicious where we live. We were on holiday here and happened to drive by and weren't disappointed.  I would like to give more stars for the food and service. The appetizer for two was phenomenal, 10 out of 10. The papadums were perfect, my Chai Masala as well. We also had the Papri Chaat, first time and not the last-- super tasty.  The sauce to the Tandoori chicken was a bit too spicy for me--I can't eat hot food at all, but the chicken and vegetables with it didn't need any sauce. They were seasoned so well I didn't need any extra sauce. The service was fast, f

Delicious food alert! 🍴 Must-try Samosas 🤤. Quality and quantity are perfekt 👍. Prices are spot on 💸. One of the best Indian restaurants in Germany 🇮🇳. Plus, it's just a short walk from Füssen Bahnhof 🚶‍♂️. Highly recommended!

Excellent tastes from India delivered with care and attention by the owners of the restaurant. The decoration and ambiance is simple but expect rather increased prices for rather small portions. There is a convenient parking across the street with 1,5 euro per hour.

stores.name: Wok In
stores.yomi: ウォック・イン
stores.short: 旧市街の気軽なアジア料理と寿司
stores.desc: 旧市街ライヒェン通りのパサージュ内にあるアジア料理店。タイ風カレー、鴨の麺、フォー、揚げ魚のゴンバオソース、巻き寿司まで幅広く、出てくるのが早い。屋外席もあり、城見学で疲れた日の気軽な夕食向き。現金払いのみとの声が多い。
stores.sig: Duck Noodles（揚げた鴨を載せた焼きそば／汁そば）

taste.quote: The duck noodles, in particular, were so good that we ended up ordering a second plate! The flavors were balanced, and the dishes were nicely presented.

review_texts.text: If you’re in Füssen and looking for quality Asian cuisine, this restaurant is a great choice. We tried the sushi platter and the duck noodles, both of which were fresh and well-prepared. The duck noodles, in particular, were so good that we ended up ordering a second plate! The flavors were balanced, and the dishes were nicely presented. The service was polite and efficient, with the staff ensuring a pleasant dining experience. It’s an ideal spot for tourists who want a calm and enjoyable meal with authentic Asian flavors. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.

Delicious Asian food, quick service and fairly priced. We tried the fried fish in gang bao sauce and fried chicken with noodles. The service was good and the food arrived very quickly. We left with stomachs full and happy hearts. Note: it's a pay by cash only restaurant.
Best crunchy rolls i've had so far! Price all right, but the Radler was a bit too sweet for my taste.  Still, good food so 5/5.
Great delicious food, large portions for the price. Welcoming staff and fresh products. Cash only!

Just finished eating here and couldn’t be happier with our choice! If you ever find yourself in Füssen and craving Asian cuisine, this place is a gem. The food is absolutely delicious—and the portions? Generous enough to feed a small army (or at least two very hungry castle tourists).  Today was still sunny and warm, so we sat outside and soaked up the lovely atmosphere. The service was friendly, fast, and had our order on the table quicker than you can say “Neuschwanstein.”  After spending five hours exploring Schwangau and the fairytale Neuschwanstein Castle, we were beyond hungry—and this m

We dropped in on a Thursday night. The host and hostess were so kind and warm. We ate a variety including the sweet and sour duck, the pho with prawns, veggie tofu and the sushi. All dishes were delicious and cooked well with generous portions. My personal favourite was the salmon and avocado inside out sushi! Avocado and salmon were so fresh and had a really good ratio to rice.

Wok In offers a convenient option for a quick meal, with an average selection of dishes at an okay cost. While the food might not be extraordinary, it provides a satisfactory dining experience for those looking for a simple and fuss-free option. The menu covers a range of Asian-inspired dishes, catering to different palates.  The affordability of the restaurant is a plus, making it a practical choice for a casual meal without breaking the bank. The ambiance is usually straightforward and functional, creating a no-frills setting that aligns with the pricing. The service is efficient, ensuring a
Very good food. Fresh. Quality - price worth it. 👌🏻 And I took also sushi take away was so good and fresh

stores.short: カラブリア仕込みの魚介イタリアン
stores.desc: 旧市街フランシスコ会小路の、カラブリア出身のフィリッポが営むリストランテ。家族のレシピで作る魚介のパスタやグリル、ピッツァが中心で、オリーブ油・パン・ハウスワインは故郷の自家農園産。夏は店前の庭席が気持ちよく、ワインの提案にも定評がある。

Das Interieur bietet ein exklusives, liebevolles Ambiente – selbiges gilt auch für den Garten vor dem Haus im Sommer. Der Service ist gut besetzt, zuvorkommend und glänzt durch gute Weinempfehlungen. review_texts.text: Wenn du in Füssen Lust auf erstklassiges Sushi und panasiatische Spezialitäten hast, führt kein Weg am Kyōdai vorbei. Das stilvolle Restaurant im Zentrum der Stadt begeistert mit frischen Zutaten, kreativen Sushi-Kreationen und einer abwechslungsreichen Karte mit Gerichten aus Japan, Thailand und Vietnam. Ob klassische Maki, opulente Sushi-Platten oder warme asiatische Spezialitäten – hier kommen Fans der asiatischen Küche voll auf ihre Kosten. Perfekt für einen besonderen Abend oder einfach, um sich etwas richtig Gutes zu gönnen!
